description: Newly incorporated active UK companies straight from Companies House, filterable by SIC code and town. Organization fields only - no directors or officer names. Free without an API key: up to 5 companies, 3 calls per hour. With an x-api-key: up to 100 companies for 20 credits ($0.20).

days.description: Look-back window in days, 1-30. Defaults to 7.
